That number comes from #north-team, a channel she's in. On 20 Aug 2025 she first posted 180, then corrected it a few minutes later to "185, not 180."

I couldn't find the amendment document itself in any file I can see, so I suggested she check with June (deal desk) if the deck has to match the signed copy exactly. A seat count is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so no approval was needed to share it.
